sentences.text: Accidents Claims Tribunal, Jabalpur (for short the "Tribunal") whereby the Tribunal has awarded sum of Rs.4,33,140/- as compensation alongwith interest from the date of institution of claim petition till realisation.

2. Brief facts are that on 03.4.2019 when appellant was going on foot from Bhukamp Colony to Dhanwantri Nagar and on reaching near Lal Baba a motorcycle bearing MP-20/SS-331 which was driven and owned by respondent No.1 and insured with respondent No.2/Insurance Company came from back side and dashed against appellant as a result of which he sustained injuries in his leg,
hand, head and other parts of body.
3. The appellant as claimant filed claim petition claiming compensation to the tune of Rs.2 lacs by stating that he was working from furniture work, he suffered permanent disablement and made lot of expenses in medical treatment.
He further suffered mental pain and agony as also loss of income.
4. The date of accident, negligence and issue of liability are not in dispute, therefore, findings of Tribunal in that regard are assailed in this appeal.
5. Learned counsel for the appellant submitted that Tribunal committed illegality in awarding less amount of compensation.
He further submitted that deceased was engaged in work of furniture and repairs and he w a s having furniture shop.
The Tribunal assessed the loss of income considering the disability to the extent of 15% whereas Doctor assessed the disability to the extent of 30%.

Hence,
prayed to enhance the amount of compensation suitably.
6. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent submitted that amount of compensation is just and proper and there is no need to enhancement the compensation amount.

7. Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, more particularly the age of the appellant, his earning, disability affecting his work income, it shall be proper to enhance the lumpsum amount of compensation by Rs.75,000/-.
The enhanced amount shall be deposited before the Tribunal within a period of two months from the date of receipt of certified copy.
The enhanced amount shall carry interest at the rate awarded by the Tribunal from the date of claim petition till realisation.
8. With the aforesaid modification in the amount of compensation, the appeal is partly allowed.

(HIRDESH) JUDGE RM Amit Vishwakarma vs Ashish Kumar Dahiya on 13 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58596353/
